events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day Mary Kay NYFW beauty activation built around the brand's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with beauty touch-ups, product discovery and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Current event sources advertise free full-size Mary Kay makeup and skin-care products plus beauty touch-ups; promotional inventory is limited.
events.caveats: Current sources describe the event as free and open to the public. Free product quantities are not guaranteed and are expected to be limited while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort Street. No mandatory advance RSVP is established by the current verified sources.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded eos × NYLON truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments on the final day of NYFW.
events.what_is_free: The public activation advertises Dewy Lip Shine product sampling and branded sweet treats; exact quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current listings explicitly describe the truck as open to the public. Samples and treats are promotional inventory and may run out before the advertised end time.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. No RSVP requirement is published.

events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 51 W 34th St, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A Hempz Serene Waters pop-up outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square centered on the brand's magnesium body-care line, with drinks, minis and promotional giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Current sources advertise free magnesium iced teas, lavender cold-foam matchas and Serene Waters mini body lotions while supplies last; the first 50 guests are advertised to receive a Calm Kit.
events.caveats: Promotional items are while supplies last. Some scratch-off prizes or gifts may be tied to in-store purchase, but purchase is not required for the public pop-up or the advertised free drinks/minis. Ulta's official store page confirms the Herald Square address as 51 W 34th Street, Suite 110 (2 Herald Square).
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square. No advance RSVP requirement is published.

events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: A two-day public in-store runway experience where visitors can walk a Century 21 runway, optionally be filmed for the store's social stories and customize a tote with iron-on patches.
events.what_is_free: Century 21's official event page says participants receive a free Century 21 tote, up to five iron-on patches pressed on site and a $21-off-$100 in-store card while supplies last.
events.caveats: Century 21 explicitly states there is no ticket and no invitation; visitors line up on the Dey Street side of the main floor. Filming is part of the activation but participation in social posting is described as opt-in. Totes are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday and Wednesday, September 15–16, from 12–6 PM each day at 22 Cortlandt Street. Walk in; no sign-up is required.

events.address: Varies by participating NYC bakery; see official store finder
events.what_it_is: Insomnia Cookies' annual PJ Party across participating bakeries, with a free cookie for guests who arrive in pajamas and additional merch/giveaways at select locations.
events.what_is_free: The official PJ Party page says guests who arrive in pajamas receive one free Classic cookie in-store from 8 PM to close. Select bakeries also have free merch and giveaways while supplies last.
events.caveats: Wear pajamas to receive the free Classic cookie. All U.S. and Canada bakeries participate in the cookie offer, but extra merchandise/giveaways vary by location and are while supplies last. Closing time varies by bakery.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 8 PM until each participating bakery closes. Use the official PJ Party page's bakery finder for the most convenient NYC location.
